name: Marine energy & ocean devices (EERE TRLs, tailored)
shortDescription: EERE TRL definitions as plain-language screening questions, plus marine and ocean-specific tailoring on top of the DoD criteria.
description: Tier 1 screening questions are adapted from the DOE EERE TRL definitions (EERE R 540.112-02); because that document defines TRL 1 through TRL 8 only, the TRL 9 question is adapted from the DoD TRA Guidebook (Feb 2025), Table 2-1. Tier 2 references the generic dod-tra-2025 criteria and adds marine-energy and ocean-observing tailoring items, each with a rationale. The level-defining criterion at each TRL is promoted to mandatory by this framework so that a level cannot be claimed without the demonstration the definition names; the underlying sources do not classify criteria as mandatory or optional.
disclaimer: Tailored criteria are this tool's additions, not agency requirements. Using this framework does not make an assessment a DOE, EERE or DoD Technology Readiness Assessment.
